sections.heading: Coming to Australia
sections.text:
How coming to Australia to reside, study or holiday can affect your residency and the tax you pay.

Check about tax, working and lodging a tax return in Australia if you're a working holiday maker (417 or 462 visa).

If you come to Australia to study, check what you need to consider if you start working.

What to do when you leave Australia if you worked here, including lodging your tax return and claiming super.

If you work in the SWP or the PLS your employer will withhold tax from your pay and you may need to lodge a tax return.

Find out about working in Australia under the PALM scheme, including residency, starting work and paying tax.

Find out about tax, working and lodging a tax return in Australia. This information may be in your chosen language.

If you're an Australian resident for tax purposes for a full year, find out about the tax-free threshold.

This information will help you work out if you are a resident while on a working holiday in Australia.

Check when working holiday makers who are Australian residents for tax purposes are taxed as Australian residents.
